title: Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake
description:
Join the enchanting world of Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake, an engaging game that combines puzzle-solving with café management. Explore a beautiful mansion, uncover family secrets, and help Emily grow her café into a culinary empire. Enjoy this unique experience for free on your phone or computer.

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, drag items.
Mobile: Tap buttons, drag items with your finger.

Key Features:
• Expand your cooking table! : Combine ingredients and find matches on the table. Merge and expand your territory! This way, you can cook more masterpieces!
• Combine ingredients! : Want to create something more complex than a sandwich? Great! Combine ingredients to unlock increasingly complex dishes.
• Restore the café! : Restore the café and other areas with the money you earn. An incredibly engaging process where you’ll see progress at every stage!

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• 21 maps
• Café. : Your grandfather's café has fallen into disrepair. Why be sad when you can restore it and make it better than before? Get to work!
• Café facade. : You've done well inside the café, great! But the facade also needs repairs, it's time to work on that too!

Story / Setting:
You've come to your grandfather's café in the countryside. Unfortunately, it has long been abandoned. Once a popular spot, it's now your task to restore it and make it even better!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Revive your grandfather's café and breathe new life into its walls! Cook delicacies for visitors and develop your kitchen by unlocking new dishes!

Q: Is there a story?
A: You lived in a big city, but you had to return. Your grandfather had an old café, but sadly, it has fallen into disrepair. Help restore it and make it better than before! You will encounter new characters—delight them with your tasty treats!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?
A: Pleasant graphics, everything looks cozy and warm. It's especially satisfying to watch the progress of the café's reconstruction. With each amount earned, you can repair and upgrade your café and move on to other locations! With each new stage, you will see progress.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game features a total of 21 locations! You will restore them one by one, cooking food and drinks. Each location is unique with its own distinct style and theme.

Q: How can I level up faster?
A: Combine ingredients to get new ones. Expand your cooking table to hold more ingredients. Upgrade your kitchen tools to cook more efficiently!

Q: What unlocks as you progress?
A: As you play, you will expand your table, allowing you to accommodate more ingredients for cooking. You will also upgrade your kitchen setup, receiving new equipment. But you won't be limited to just the kitchen. New locations will unlock as you progress through the game!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can be bought/upgraded?
A: Upgrade the café and other locations. And don't forget about kitchen tools. With them, you can cook more delicious food!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: You start with an abandoned coffee shop and gradually, step by step, restore it. It's very engaging to watch life return to a once-popular place!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: You can play anywhere and even without sound if that suits you better.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: From the first missions, the game will show you what to do and how to do it. Additionally, hints will guide you in moments where you might miss something. But don’t worry, you’ll understand everything quickly!

title: PVZ Fusion Cheats
description:
Check out the new version of Plants vs Zombies – everything is new here, but the classics are still there!

Now you can not only fight off zombies with the help of your green friends, but also make cool hybrid plants. These are plants that combine the powers of two or even more ordinary plants.

With these hybrids, you'll get a bunch of new chips to deal with zombies that have become even cooler, smarter, and more cunning!

Controls:
Desktop: Mouse: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.  
Mobile: Finger: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.

Key Features:
• Selection: Combine plants to create unique species with their own abilities and appearances.  
• Challenges: Test your skills in various challenges that will provide new experiences and challenge your tactics.  
• Cheats: Cheats let you go wild: take as many sun points as you want and plant as many plants as you can.  
• Skins: You can purchase skins for your plants themed around popular memes.

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Sun Points: The in-game currency that allows you to buy plants and place them in your garden. Sometimes they may fall from the sky, or sunflowers may give them to you. You can also obtain them by pressing the cheats button.  
• Dollars: In-game currency that can be spent on bonuses (e.g., cooldown-free gloves) or to buy new challenges. You can earn dollars by completing levels, from daily rewards, or by purchasing them with Gam.  
• Gam: Premium currency used to buy dollars or skins.

Game Modes:
• Adventure: A more classic mode with basic challenges. Completing a level in this mode unlocks a new one with tougher opponents and possibly a different appearance.  
• Challenges: A mode that offers new experiences. Each challenge can surprise you. For example, in one challenge, you can play as a zombie.

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Nut: Holds back zombies in front of you, buying time to fend off the attack.  
• It's fine Nut: A skin inspired by the "It's fine" meme.

Story / Setting:
The setting is a zombie apocalypse where hordes of zombies are trying to break into your home.

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: The game is about defending your garden from hordes of zombies. Build defenses with various plants, devise unique tactics, and protect your garden from waves of monsters.

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: Do not let the zombies break into your home. You need to prepare to fend off all waves and achieve victory.

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?  
A: You can start combining plants right from the first minutes of the game, creating unique combinations. Each one can produce a special plant with its own abilities and distinctive traits.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: You will find many levels: from quite familiar to levels with special challenges. Completing a level unlocks a new one, and so on.

Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: As you progress through the game, new levels with tougher opponents become available.

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Yes, you can adjust the difficulty in the game based on your readiness.

Q: How can I level up faster?  
A: The game features free progression. Thanks to the cheat feature, you can give yourself as much currency as you want. With it, you can buy plants to defend your garden, so there are no barriers to how many plants you want to purchase.

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/improve?  
A: You can buy bonuses and skins in the game. For example, a time acceleration x3 or a skin for a plant.

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Yes, you can purchase various skins for your plants in the game.

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: Most plants in the game are available from the start, allowing for great opportunities for unique combinations from the first levels.

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: You can play without sound. The game is intuitive, so sound is not essential. However, with sound, you will immerse yourself better in the world.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: Yes, there is a brief tutorial at the beginning that provides basic knowledge. It does not overwhelm with information. After that, you immediately start playing a level, testing your knowledge in practice and discovering new possibilities.

title: Plants vs Zombies Fusion Mode
description:
Welcome to the updated world of Plants vs. Zombies, where innovation is intertwined with tradition!

In this game, you have the opportunity not only to defend your home from zombies with the help of an army of plants, but also to create unique hybrid plants that combine the abilities of two or more original plants.

These hybrids give you unlimited tactical options to fight new waves of zombies that have become smarter, stronger, and more cunning!

Controls:
Desktop: Mouse: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.  
Mobile: Finger: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.

Key Features:
• Crossbreed Plants!: Combine plants to create unique specimens! They will surprise you with their appearance and abilities, and can pose a serious threat to zombies!  
• Meme Skins.: Dress your plants in skins. Some are inspired by popular memes!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Sun Points.: Earn them through sunflowers and purchase plants in-game to strengthen your defense!  
• Dollars.: Earn them by completing levels! You can use them to buy bonuses, challenges, and special plants in the shop!  
• Premium Currency.: Purchase special skins for your favorite plants!

Game Modes:
• Adventure: Defend your home by fending off waves, level by level, and defeat bosses by planting an unbreakable defense with your plants!  
• Challenges: Special levels with unique trials. Play as zombies or fend off monster attacks using only plants from gifts — you never know which plant you’ll get! There are challenges for every taste.

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Cabbage Pult: A plant that launches a cabbage head straight at zombies. The enemy won't know what hit them when it lands on their head!  
• Torch Wood: Helps turn projectiles launched by other plants into fiery ones! Roast those monsters!

Enemies / Bosses:
• Zombie Door.: Look out. This zombie had the clever idea to take a door and use it as a shield! I wonder what he'll do when your plants break it.  
• Super Driver Zombie.: Beware! This zombie is charging straight at you. Destroy him quickly before he crushes your plants! Deal as much damage as you can, and fast!

Story / Setting:
The zombie apocalypse has begun. The world is crawling with monsters eager for brains! Protect your home by planting living plants!

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: The zombie apocalypse has arrived! Zombies are taking over this world. Your plants can stop them! Plant your backyard defense to keep them from reaching your home!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: Don’t let the zombies into the house! Plant lines of defense with different plants to stop them and destroy all waves of monsters!

Q: What hooks you in the first few minutes?  
A: The pleasant music immerses you in this world. And if you find yourself short on plants, you can create unique species by combining them! They will differ not only in appearance but also in abilities!

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: Levels follow one after another, keeping boredom at bay. Each new level will introduce you to new plants and enemies!

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Each subsequent level is harder than the last. You’ll need to strategize your defense and crossbreed plants to withstand the zombie onslaught!

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: Plant more sunflowers! They give you sun points, which you can use to buy plants for your defense. Don’t hold back. Zombies won’t spare any effort to break through to you!

Q: What unlocks as you progress?  
A: New plants, along with new combinations, which will give you unique species with their own abilities.

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/improve?  
A: Purchase bonuses that will help you in the game. For example, speed up the game by 3 times if you want a faster pace. Special plants are also available in the shop.

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Unlock skins for your plants! Many of them are themed around popular memes. Even zombies won’t be indifferent to them!

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: The Peashooter and Sunflower. The most basic plants, but indispensable in battle. Sunflowers will provide you with sun points to buy new plants, while the Peashooter is your loyal and brave guardian. It shoots peas and stops zombies trying to get into the house.

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there daily rewards / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?  
A: Earn daily rewards for logging in! It’s always nice to return, as a surprise awaits you!

Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: Want to play in silence? No one will stop you from doing that.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: The first levels of the game will introduce you to all the mechanics and plants, so you can quickly understand how to build your defense effectively. You’ll grasp everything within the first levels!

title: Soccer Random
description:
Soccer Random is a funny physics-based soccer game where every match feels unpredictable from the first kick. Instead of following the style of a serious football simulation, it turns soccer into a fast, chaotic, and easy-to-play challenge built around one-button controls. Your goal is simple: jump, kick, defend, and try to score before your opponent reaches the winning number of goals. The rules are clear, but the movement is never fully predictable, which is what makes each round so entertaining.

The game uses ragdoll-style character movement, so players do not run, turn, or shoot in a traditional way. They bounce, fall, stretch, and swing toward the ball with awkward timing. A perfect-looking attack can suddenly miss, while a strange jump may turn into an unexpected goal. This mix of timing, reaction, and random physics gives Soccer Random its playful identity. It is easy to understand in seconds, but every match still creates surprising moments.

One of the strongest parts of Soccer Random is how the game changes between rounds. The field, players, weather-like conditions, ball behavior, and match rhythm can shift after a goal. You may play on a regular soccer field in one round, then face a slippery or unusual setup in the next. These random changes keep the experience fresh and stop the matches from feeling repetitive. Players must quickly adapt instead of relying on the same move every time.

Soccer Random can be played alone against the CPU, but it becomes even more enjoyable in local 2-player mode. Two players can share the same device and compete in short, messy football duels where both sides are dealing with the same unpredictable movement. Because the controls are simple, the match stays focused on timing, quick reactions, and funny mistakes rather than complicated button combinations.

The pixel art style gives the game a clean, retro look that fits well with its arcade feeling. The visuals are simple enough to keep the action easy to follow, while the strange animations make every goal, save, and missed kick more memorable. A small bounce, a late jump, or an accidental block can completely change the result of a round.

For players who enjoy quick soccer games, local 2-player challenges, and funny sports games with random physics, Soccer Random offers a light but highly replayable experience. It works well for short sessions because the matches start quickly, the goal is always clear, and every round can produce a new kind of chaos. Whether you are trying to beat the CPU or challenge a friend, Soccer Random keeps football simple, strange, and entertaining from one goal to the next.

title: Word Finder
description:
🐹Playing Word Finder 10 minutes a day sharpens your mind and prepares you for your daily life and challenges!🐹

Would you like to relax, exercise your brain, and expand your vocabulary-all at the same time? With Word Finder, the brand NEW & incredibly addicting word game!

Take your daily medication and ease your mind while enjoying all the fun from Word Finder!

FEATURES

● SHIFTING TILES. Each puzzle shifts as you find words. 
● LOTS OF LEVELS. Play over 6000 levels with more coming soon.

title: Moto X3M
description:
Moto X3M is an awesome bike game with challenging levels. Choose a bike, put your helmet on, pass obstacles, and get ready to beat the time on tons of off-road circuits. Have fun with Moto X3M! The controls are simple – use the keyboard arrow keys to control the acceleration and deceleration, and also your tilt. Ride through each course and try to land your jumps perfectly – if you angle your bike incorrectly you risk tipping your bike over! 
Each level features different obstacles and objects for you to traverse – you will find this game both fun and challenging! This is off-road biking to the max and for any motorbike fan, this game will provide a huge amount of enjoyment!

title: Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game
description:
🎯 Challenge yourself and create a giant fruit! Start by merging two smaller fruits to eventually form a gigantic one. It’s a feat only 1% of players have achieved. Are you ready to join that elite group?

Game Main Features:
- Exciting Fruit Matching 🍒: Test your brain by combining the same fruits and observing their remarkable transformation!
- Tactical Gameplay 🧠: Use thoughtful strategies to keep the fruits from spilling out of the container.
- Thrilling Transformations 🔄: Discover and unlock new fruit varieties as you progress in the game.
- Captivating and Fun 😄: Lose yourself in hours of amusement and delight with this unique fruit-matching adventure.

title: Sprunki
description:
Sprunki Incredibox Original – Create your own melody using a combination of different sounds!
Dive into the world of Sprunki Incredibox Original, where music comes to life right before your eyes and creative freedom knows no bounds. Create your own melodies with the charismatic Sprunki characters!  Game Features: 🎼 Unlimited musical possibilities: Discover hundreds of sound combinations that are perfect for you.  🧩 Complete creative freedom: Play your way—no restrictions, just mix and experiment.  🌟 Find the best combinations: Choose the ideal rhythms and melodies to craft your unique musical style.  🎧 Engaging and relaxing: Perfect for laid-back gameplay and inspiring musical experimentation.  In Sprunki Incredibox Original, everything is simple and fun: drag characters, mix rhythms, and create tracks with no limits. You are the composer, and each sound combination is your own unique musical masterpiece.

title: Geometry Arrow 2
description:
Geometry Arrow 2 ─ sequel of the game about the arrow in the cave.

The goal of the game is to reach the end of the cave (the portal) alive. Along the way, you need to dodge unique obstacles.

In the new part, a new game character has been added ─ the "Wheel"
And now you can customize your arrow and ball looks, change game particles and blocks textures.

The game has 13 levels of varying difficulty. Each level consists of "Arrow" segments and new "Wheel" segments.

title: Mahjong Puzzle: Tile Match
description: Mahjong Puzzle: Tile Match is a soothing yet brain-teasing tile-matching game where you clear the board by linking identical tiles in smart rows and columns. You study every layout, spot hidden patterns, and plan each move ahead. As difficulty rises, you test your focus, relax your mind, and sharpen your puzzle-solving instincts.

title: Kick Lucky Blocks Online
description:
Kick Lucky Blocks Online is a colorful progression adventure built around distance, upgrades, and reward hunting. Your objective is to kick lucky blocks across expanding arenas, chase them through dangerous areas, and return safely with valuable rewards before tsunamis flood the map. The farther the lucky block travels, the better your chances of unlocking rare Brainrots and high-tier lucky boxes.

Every run creates a balance between risk and reward. Some players focus on safe farming and consistent upgrades, while others push deeper into dangerous zones searching for stronger Brainrots and limited rewards. The game keeps progression active by constantly opening new areas, upgrades, and collection goals.

Explore and Collect
More than 75 Brainrot characters can be discovered throughout 14 unique areas. Different zones contain different reward pools, making later arenas much more valuable but also more dangerous. Brainrots appear in multiple variants including Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Toxic, Lava, Candy, and more.

The rarity system ranges from Common and Rare all the way to Celestial, Divine, Ascended, Eternal, Omniversal, and Supreme tiers. Some of the rarest Brainrots only appear during events or special moments, encouraging players to keep improving their routes and upgrades.

Upgrade Your Power
Players can improve kick distance using weights, increase movement speed, rebirth for higher income rates, and expand their base with more floors and storage slots. Stronger upgrades help players reach deeper destinations and return safely with more rewards.

Managing progression becomes an important part of the experience. Choosing when to spend currency, rebirth, or risk deeper arenas can completely change the pace of future runs.

Online and Local Multiplayer
The online mode is available in solo play and supports chat, room joining, and player invites. Local 2-player mode allows two players to compete or progress together on the same device, creating a more social experience.

Customization and Live Events
Character customization includes clothes, wings, hats, glasses, and different bag styles. Live events such as Diamond Rain, Rainbow, Toxic, Volcano, and Candy events regularly introduce better rewards and rare Brainrot opportunities.

Why the Game Feels Rewarding
Kick Lucky Blocks Online combines simple controls with satisfying progression. Every kick can unlock stronger rewards, better areas, and faster growth. Between collection mechanics, survival moments, upgrades, and replayable runs, the game delivers a fun gameplay loop that stays engaging over time.

title: Arrow Exit Puzzle
description:
🔓 Unlock your logic with Arrow Away!
Looking for a satisfying brain workout? Arrow Away is a minimalist logic puzzle game that challenges your spatial thinking. Can you find the correct sequence to clear every arrow from the grid? 🧩

In this addictive arrow puzzle, you must use your IQ to navigate through complex boards. Whether you call it a brain teaser or a logic game, the goal is simple: clear the board by tapping arrows in the right order. 💡

title: Sudoku Online
description:
Sudoku Puzzle is a free online Sudoku game. No registration, play instantly in your browser.

The classic mode offers four difficulty levels: Easy for beginners, Medium for steady practice, Hard for experienced players, and Expert for those who seek a real challenge. Additional game modes expand the standard rules: X-Sudoku adds diagonal constraints, Windoku introduces extra regions on the grid, Killer Sudoku requires groups of cells to meet a target sum, and Kropki adds ratio and difference markers between adjacent cells.

Every puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable through pure logic — no guessing required. If you get stuck, a step was missed somewhere, and it can always be traced back.

Sudoku Puzzle is also a competitive experience. Leaderboards track rankings by level, score, and wins. Personal profiles store game history and detailed statistics. The chat lets players connect, share strategies, and challenge each other.

title: Car Destruction King
description:
Drive different cars, test your strength with rotating hammers, presses, catapults and other obstacles!

title: Driver Club: Highway Racing

Driver Club: Highway Racing is a high speed driving game where you dodge traffic, overtake vehicles, and put your reflexes to the test.

Race through a variety of dynamic environments
Unlock and drive a range of powerful cars
Smooth, responsive controls for an immersive experience
Stunning visuals that enhance the thrill of the ride
Push your limits and dominate the highway leaderboard

title: Steal An Egg - Grow Animals

description:
Welcome to block's world — a huge 3D sandbox where anything is possible!
Want to build? Grab blocks and create houses, castles and whole cities. Love adventure? Explore caves, forests and villages. Not afraid of danger? Switch to survival mode — zombies and monsters come out at night, and you'll have to defend yourself!
🧱 What awaits you:

— Survival Mode: gather resources, craft tools, fight off enemies

— Dozens of block and item types

— Dynamite to blow everything up

— Friendly graphics and easy controls for kids
The cube world is waiting for its hero. Build, craft, survive — play your way!

title: The Tall Man
description:
The Tall Man is a horror game where you explore darkness, searching for clues with only a weak light to guide you. But something is watching, always, just out of sight.

In this first-person horror survival game, the player navigates a dark, desolate forest at night with the primary objective of collecting nine mysterious pages scattered across the environment before a supernatural entity arrives. Movement is cautious and tense, utilizing a flashlight with a depleting battery to illuminate looming pine trees, abandoned structures, and rusted vehicles. The core gameplay loop focuses on exploration and stealth, where success depends on finding all collectibles while managing limited light sources to avoid the looming threat. The visual style is rooted in a gritty, realistic 3D aesthetic featuring a high-contrast palette of deep blacks, navy blues, and cold grays, creating a chilling atmosphere punctured only by the harsh yellow glow of the flashlight. A persistent HUD displays a countdown timer for the Slender-inspired Tallman, a page counter, a flashlight battery indicator, and a mini-map for navigation. The setting is a classic horror woodland characterized by tall, spindly trees and foggy patches, evoking a sense of isolation and vulnerability. The protagonist appears as a generic human figure in a pinkish sleeve, seen only via their hand clutching the light. The emotional tone is high-tension and creepy, targeting teens and adult fans of the urban legend horror genre who enjoy skill-heavy survival mechanics and jumpscares. Progression is measured by the increasing number of pages found, which heightens the difficulty and atmospheric soundscapes as the player nears the final objective.

title: Age of Tanks Warriors: TD War
description:
Lead Your Tank Warriors to Glory Across Time!
Welcome to Age of Tank Warriors: TD War, the ultimate tank warriors strategy game! Travel through the ages of war, leading your tank army from Stone Age warriors to the sci-fi space future. Upgrade your battle tanks, engage in intense Clash of Tank Warriors battles, and use tower defense (TD) strategy to conquer every era. 100vs100 survival battles await—will you rewrite history and become the greatest tank warlord?

title: Arrow Cube 3D
description: Remove every arrow from the six-sided cube by finding the perfect order. Arrow Cube Escape is a calm 3D logic puzzle that challenges your focus, planning, and spatial thinking in short, satisfying levels.

title: Golf Orbit
description:
Golf Orbit is an exciting golf simulator game within sports category where you aim to launch golf balls to incredible heights, even reaching Mars. Have fun in one-shot golf battles, complete challenging levels, and master the art of the perfect shot. Compete to become the golf king in this entertaining and unique golfing adventure.

Core: A vibrant and highly accessible casual sports title centered on the fundamentals of golf.
Loop: Player skill is directly rewarded with in-game currency for successful long-range shots, facilitating a clear progression path through continuous gear upgrades.
Start: The game features highly intuitive controls and is immediately engaging, supported by a robust system of mini-quests to drive early-game retention.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Features a polished Stylized / Cartoon art direction, providing an appealing and universally pleasant visual experience.
Key Feature: Offers an enjoyable blend of satisfying gameplay challenge coupled with eye-catching, high-quality graphics.

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons and move the cursor.
Mobile: Tap buttons with your finger, drag your finger across the screen.

Key Features:
• Hit Accurately! : Try to hit the green indicator for a stronger shot and to make the ball fly further!
• Hit the Green Zones! : Did you hit the green zone? Great! Now take another shot!
• Obstacles on the Field! : Hit harder to make the ball fly higher! There can be various obstacles on the field, like trees, rocks, or even someone's house...

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Go play golf! Hit the ball as far as possible and try to get it into the holes.

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: Get the ball into the holes or the green zones, then take another shot. Aim more accurately to avoid missing, or you'll have to start over!

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?
A: Try to hit the green section on the indicator when you take a shot. This way, you can hit harder, and your ball will fly further!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/improve?
A: Upgrade your abilities: ball flight speed, shot power, and more. Get better and hit the target directly!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily rewards / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?
A: Spin the wheel of fortune to earn more rewards. Test your luck!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Play however you feel comfortable! You can choose to turn off the sound.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: From the first moments of the game, you'll immediately understand how to play! Improve your skills shot by shot!

title: MR RACER - Car Racing

Customize and upgrade your rides to stay ahead of the curve. Choose from eye-catching paint jobs, cool wheels, and performance boosts to dominate every track.

title: BMG: Ragdoll Car Race
description:
"BMG: Ragdoll Car Race" is a crash test simulator with plenty of destruction and obstacles that will easily destroy your car.
Immerse yourself in the crazy world of ragdoll racing, where physics is the main source of fun and unexpected situations. A huge open world awaits you, filled with diverse locations, hidden routes, and challenges that will test not only your speed but also your driving skills. Complete unique levels with varying conditions—from extreme tracks to complex stunt zones—where every collision turns into a spectacular show thanks to a realistic destruction system.

title: Sky Wars: Battle of the Islands
description: Sky Wars is a blocky island-battle game for one player against seven bots. Everyone spawns in a glass cage on a floating island with three chests. Loot swords, armor, bows, ender pearls and golden apples, bridge block by block to the middle island for better loot, and knock rivals into the void. Every 2.5 minutes the super chest in the center unlocks with top-tier diamond gear. title: Block Blast 2048
description:
Block Blast 2048 is a calm yet engaging number puzzle where it’s easy to relax while sharpening your logic. Merge adjacent blocks with the same numbers, watch them grow into larger values, and move step by step toward new high scores.

The game doesn’t rush you — you choose your own pace and strategy. Simple rules make it easy to understand from the first seconds, while the thoughtful gameplay keeps you coming back. Easy to start, fun to continue.

Why you should try it:

- Intuitive one-tap block merging

- Pleasant design and a relaxing atmosphere

- Perfect for short breaks or long play sessions

- Play at your own pace — no timers, no stress

- Gradually increasing difficulty without pressure

This is a game you’ll want to return to again and again. Merge, upgrade, and enjoy the process!

title: Color Sort Puzzle Milk Tea Sorting

💡 Why you’ll love it:

Easy to learn, hard to master gameplay

Relaxing visuals with vibrant colors
No time limits — play at your own pace
Hundreds of challenging levels
Perfect brain training and stress relief

Whether you want to relax or test your logic skills, this game offers the perfect balance of challenge and calm.

Can you solve all the levels and become a sorting master?

“Geometry: Black Wave” is a musical platformer game in which the player controls a small arrow, overcoming various obstacles and hurdles on the way to the finish line. The game features black and white graphics and an exciting soundtrack that is synchronized with the gameplay.

The game offers many levels of varying difficulty, each with its own unique music. The player must react quickly to obstacles and move in the right direction to reach the end of the level.

“Geometry: Black Wave” is a game that requires the player to react quickly and move accurately. It is suitable for all ages and skill levels, and can be a great way to pass the time and have fun.

title: Mahjong 3

Embark on a fairytale adventure!

title: Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator
description:
Dive into the exhilarating world of car crashes with the Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator. Perfect for those who love realistic car destruction and high-speed racing, this free online game is accessible on both mobile and PC. Prepare for an entertaining experience filled with destruction physics!

Controls:
Desktop: WASD — movement, right mouse button to click buttons, ZX — left and right turn signals. Mouse wheel — zoom in/out camera, left mouse button — rotate camera.
Mobile: Tap the buttons. Left/right buttons, accelerate forward, reverse.

Key Features:
• Realistic controls: The game features highly accurate controls, along with vehicle destructibility. Watch as cars crumple, tear apart, and explode into pieces!
• Create your own levels: If the basic maps aren't enough for you, create your own — you decide what will be on your map and how it will look!
• Choose your car: Pick the car you like and hit the road! Wonder how long your journey will be.

Game Modes:
• Classic mode: A classic mode where you can play on 8 ready-made maps and test the cars!
• Map Editor: A separate large world where you can create your own maps as your heart desires. Come up with your own challenges and obstacles or just create something unique.

Vehicles / Cars:
• Caro: A powerful muscle car. It will impress you with its speed and power. See how it withstands obstacles in its path!
• Flash: The futuristic electric car! Powerful and fast enough. Watch how it takes a hit!
• Syper: A sports car designed specifically for speed. Street racing is its forte, but how will it perform on the map? Find out!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Test the cars' durability by completing challenges, or create your own! It's your sandbox where you can play as you wish! Choose a car and go racing on the map! You can complete challenges or immediately destroy your car on the first obstacle! Watch as cars turn into heaps of metal, or try to keep them intact. The choice is yours!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: This is your sandbox where you set the rules. Destroy cars and enjoy watching them explode, or try to keep them whole!

Q: What grabs attention in the first minutes?
A: Realistic controls and driving physics allow for realistic scenarios. You can turn on the turn signal, honk, and even get out of the car or drive from a first-person perspective, witnessing all the chaos from inside! A wide selection of maps lets you play out numerous scenarios!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: There are 8 maps in the game, each differing in challenges and content. But if that's not enough, you can create your own map in the map editor! You're not limited in possible scenarios!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: Unlock new cars and test their durability! See how many challenges they can withstand.

Economy & Customization
Q: Are there skins / customization?
A: Paint the cars in your desired color and see how they perform on the map!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Most cars in the game are available from the start. Begin your journey with the car you like!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not mandatory, but it can enhance the emotional experience!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it entail?
A: At the beginning of the game, you'll be taught how to control the car, and from the first seconds, you'll understand what to do!

title: +1 Speed: Escape Prison

Level up your speed, complete obstacle courses, and master parkour to find the best escape route. The further you go, the faster you get—feel the thrill of increasing speed and overcoming obstacles!

The prison is full of traps, guards, and dangerous zones. Can you pull off the perfect prison break and escape faster than anyone else?

Game Features:

🔶 A thrilling prison break

🔶 Dynamic parkour-style gameplay +1 to speed

🔶 Gradual acceleration and challenging trials

🔶 Diverse levels and obstacles

🔶 Ability to level up your character

Start your escape right now and prove you can break out of prison!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?
A: You need to escape from prison by overcoming obstacles, jumping, running, and doing parkour. It is important to improve your movement speed and stamina because stamina affects movement speed during the escape levels.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: No.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? How can it engage players?
A: There are various features like pets that provide bonuses to movement speed and stamina, a wheel of fortune, leaderboards, and character customization.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: Are there bosses in the game, and how are they different?
A: No.

Q: How does leveling up work? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: You need to train in the gym and improve your movement speed and stamina.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: There are regular money and diamonds that can be spent on different skins, faster movement speed and stamina upgrades, and the ability to return to the last checkpoint upon losing.

Q: Is there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making a donation speed up game progress?
A: You can buy skins and in-game currency.

Q: Is there a leaderboard? How to access it? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: There are three different leaderboards: one for the highest stamina, one for the highest movement speed, and one for the player who has progressed the furthest during the escape.

Retention & Engagement

Q: What are some engaging elements of the content (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: There are many cool skins and epic music during the escape.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can the appearance of the hero be customized, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
